-- Every declaration also takes the ambient section variables (left out below): the Go semantics
-- (`ext`, `ffi`, `go_gctx`, `sem`, the package's `Assumptions`), `GF`, `hG`, `StorageModel GF`, `AllG GF`.

theorem etcdstart.onceUpTo_of_prefix (L L' C : mvcc.Log) (hwf : mvcc.LogWf' L') (hL : L <+: L') (hp
    : L <+: C) (hnd : ∀ (cs : List mvcc.Change), cs ∈ List.drop 1 C → (List.map mvcc.Change.key
    cs).Nodup) (lo : Nat) (c : Int) : mvcc.api.onceUpTo L lo c

    go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.Assumptions] [v3rpc_sem :
    go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.etcdserver.api.v3rpc.Assumptions] (V : client.WEnv GF) (γ : KVNames)
    (hst : γ.st = V.kst) (Pw : List (List mvcc.Change) → Prop) (hP : ∀ (ch : List (List
    mvcc.Change)), Pw ch → ∀ (cs : List mvcc.Change), cs ∈ ch → (List.map mvcc.Change.key cs).Nodup)
    : (client.srvKVFacts V ∗ kvReadAu γ fun σ => iprop(⌜Pw σ.changes⌝)) ⊢ v3rpc.srvOnce V.W
